name: Tarangire, Serengeti & Ngorongoro Safari (5D/4N) | Budget

days.title: Arrival – Arusha
days.text: Airport pick-up from Kilimanjaro or Arusha. Transfer to your hotel for safari briefing and rest.

days.title: Day 1 – Tarangire National Park
days.text: Full-day game drive in Tarangire, famous for massive elephant herds, ancient baobab trees and seasonal wildlife gatherings.

days.title: Day 2 – Serengeti National Park
days.text: Scenic drive through the Ngorongoro Highlands into the iconic Serengeti. Afternoon game drive in big cat territory.

days.title: Day 3 – Full Day Serengeti
days.text: Explore endless plains on full-day game drives. Exceptional chances to spot lions, cheetahs, leopards and large wildebeest herds.

days.title: Day 4 – Serengeti to Ngorongoro
days.text: Morning game drive before heading to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Enjoy crater highland views and Maasai landscapes.
days.overnight: Lodge on crater rim or Karatu

days.title: Day 5 – Ngorongoro Crater → Arusha
days.text: Descend into the Ngorongoro Crater, one of Africa’s most wildlife-dense ecosystems. Spot rhino, lions, buffalo, elephants and flamingos before returning to Arusha.

name: Serengeti & Ngorongoro Safari (4D/3N) | Budget
intro: Start/End: Arusha. This is a private safari and you will be accomodate at public campsite. A chef and guide will be travelling with the group.

days.title: Arrival – Arusha
days.text: Airport pick-up from Kilimanjaro or Arusha. Transfer to your hotel, safari briefing, and rest before the adventure begins.

days.title: Day 1 – Serengeti National Park
days.text: Early departure and heading to Serengeti via Northern gate. Afternoon game drive in the iconic Serengeti. Expect lions, elephants, giraffes, cheetahs, wildebeest and more.

days.title: Day 2 – Serengeti National Park
days.text: You can choose for optional activities in the morning like Ballon Safari, followed by entire day of game drive. You will also get to enjoy picnic lunch during the game drive.

days.title: Day 3 – Serengeti - Ngorongoro
days.text: Morning game drive in Serengeti followed by transfer to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. You will arrive at the camp situated on rim of Ngorongoro Crater just before the sunset and spend the evening relaxing and enjoying amazing sunset.

days.title: Day 4 – Ngorongoro Crater - Arusha
days.text: Descend into the Ngorongoro Crater, one of Africa’s most wildlife-dense regions. The advantage of staying close to the crater is we will descend early in the morning avoiding the crowd. Spot rhino, lions, buffalo, hippos and flamingos before returning to Arusha. Drop-off at hotel or airport.
